description: Known-answer tests for the identity/did-usage-and-verification.md section 5 binding digests: document_digest over the normalized DID Document projection, evidence_digest over the canonical evidence receipt (did-binding-contracts.schema.json#/$defs/evidence_receipt), and policy_digest over the canonical resolver policy snapshot (#/$defs/resolver_policy_snapshot). All digests are sha256:lowercase_hex(SHA-256(RFC8785_JCS(object))). Every case is trust-domain-local: recomputability and change-sensitivity are asserted, cross-deployment equality is not.

cases.name: document_digest_normalized_projection
assertions: re-serializing the same document with any other raw JSON property order MUST produce the same digest
removing also_known_as MUST change the digest to sha256:830ea6ac9339b57a6257e412ae99fbffacb478fbcc01fa96bccd2fd719fbbad7
removing both also_known_as and metadata.primary_handle MUST change the digest to sha256:951e391daca1b97ab1636d900a98c5913313ce8e3390ac10edb8bf8f08ab1668
duplicate or conflicting property, verification-method id, service id, metadata key, relationship or extension name MUST fail before digesting
a raw resolver response digest MUST NOT be carried in document_digest; raw bytes use raw_document_digest

cases.name: evidence_receipt_proofless_method
assertions: a proofless method degrades to an empty method_proofs array, never to an implementation-invented placeholder object
the receipt MUST be retained so the digest is recomputable by an auditor

cases.name: evidence_receipt_webvh_log
assertions: witnesses MUST be sorted by witness_did in UTF-8 byte order and duplicates rejected; resolver response order is not a canonical order
changing any witness row or the witness_proofs_digest MUST change evidence_digest

the extracted evidence_dependencies record for this receipt is {witness_dids:[did:web:witness-a.example, did:web:witness-b.example], witness_controlling_organization_dids:[did:web:witness-org-a.example, did:web:witness-org-b.example], history_heads:[1-QmZfixtureEntryHash11111111111111111111111]}

cases.name: policy_snapshot_base_profile
assertions: flipping fail_mode to allow_cached_on_error MUST change the digest to sha256:a0538d5c6aa75fabf0492476e68d3a97bf35ff050ee8df601f3f62cf98b8b595
enum values MUST use the registered wire tokens; a language-native debug rendering such as FailClosed MUST be rejected before digesting
an unknown policy_profile, an unknown profile_policy field, or a missing registered field MUST fail closed instead of digesting
